window.notes: The 750 rows spanning the EHZ1 exit into the second special stage at movie row 13712, so the window crosses a level transition and a new music epoch opens inside it. Recaptured for the two-site observer: every transfer now carries an explicit site, and the music site observes the store at loc_10C0 (docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:1302-1304), which move.b D0,$09(A1,D1.w) at 0x10D6 never reaches. The capture is bounded to this window, so source_first_row and source_exclusive_end are the window's own bounds.

production_bound_meaning: The payload's own metadata line carries production_bound:false and that value is preserved verbatim. This fixture is a committed comparison reference and binds nothing to a production producer. Nothing here hydrates engine state: it is comparison-only, MEASUREMENT_ONLY at the gate.
